notes: A tool rather than a service, recorded so a reader searching for free tunnels meets that fact. Corrected 2026-10-23: the row was `qualifies`, which read as a free service. The software is free and the path is not, because it needs a host a user does not own. It is usable only on a rented or free compute service, and that service is the finding, not frp.
